items.text: Partially drain the pool and refill it with fresh water.

notes.text: If you drain, refill straight away and skip the other steps, unless there's algae: treat that first.
Don't drain if the water table is high.

items.text: With the pump running, spread alkalinity increaser over the water: **6 lb 13 oz** in total, never more than **9 lb** at once.
Retest after adding half.
If you add it in more than one dose, wait **4 hours** between doses.
Wait **4 hours** after the last dose.

notes.text: Don't add it on the same day as calcium increaser.

options.name: Muriatic acid
options.detail: Never more than **15 fl oz** at once.

options.name: Dry acid
options.detail: Never more than **1 lb 2 oz** at once.

items.text: Add each dose to a bucket with at least **1 gallon** of pool water (acid into water, never water into acid), then pour it in with the pump running.
Retest after adding half.
Wait **4 hours** between doses and **4 hours** after the last one.

items.lead: With the pump running, add one of these:

items.text: Wait **4 hours**.

notes.text: Don't swim until free chlorine is **2–4 ppm**.
Consider turning up the salt generator.

items.text: Clean the filter.

options.name: Liquid stabiliser
options.detail: Pour into the skimmer with the pump running.

options.name: Granular stabiliser
options.detail: In two halves: mix each in a bucket of pool water, pour into the skimmer, wait **2 hours** between halves.

items.text: Wait **2 hours**.

notes.text: With granular, don't clean the filter for **72 hours**. Retest after **24 hours** (liquid) or **72 hours** (granular).

items.text: With the pump running, pour **50 lb 10 oz** of pool salt slowly around the pool edge.
Brush the pool floor.
Wait **24 hours** for it to dissolve.

notes.text: Don't add salt if the water is below **60 °F**.

weekly.note: Set the generator to hold this
Only with heavy use, animals or debris
